templates.curl:
# File Upload
curl -X POST {{BASE_URL}}/v1/images/edits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{API_KEY}}" \
  -F "model={{MODEL_ID}}" \
  -F "image[]=@input.png" \
  -F "prompt=Replace the text on the sign with OPEN" \
  -F "size=1024x1024" \
  -F "quality=high"

# Image URL
curl -X POST {{BASE_URL}}/v1/images/edits \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{API_KEY}}" \
  -d '{
    "model": "{{MODEL_ID}}",
    "image": "https://example.com/input.jpg",
    "prompt": "Replace the text on the sign with OPEN",
    "size": "1024x1024",
    "quality": "high"
  }'
templates.curl_json:
curl -X POST {{BASE_URL}}/v1/images/edits \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{API_KEY}}" \
  -d '{ "model": "{{MODEL_ID}}", "image": "https://example.com/input.jpg", "prompt": "Replace the text on the sign with OPEN", "size": "1024x1024", "quality": "high" }'
templates.python:
# File Upload
import requests

with open("input.png", "rb") as image_file:
    response = requests.post(
        "{{BASE_URL}}/v1/images/edits",
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer {{API_KEY}}"},
        data={
            "model": "{{MODEL_ID}}",
            "prompt": "Replace the text on the sign with OPEN",
            "size": "1024x1024",
            "quality": "high",
        },
        files=[("image[]", ("input.png", image_file, "image/png"))],
        timeout=120,
    )

response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json()["data"][0]["b64_json"])

# Image URL
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "{{BASE_URL}}/v1/images/edits",
    headers={
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Authorization": "Bearer {{API_KEY}}",
    },
    json={
        "model": "{{MODEL_ID}}",
        "image": "https://example.com/input.jpg",
        "prompt": "Replace the text on the sign with OPEN",
        "size": "1024x1024",
        "quality": "high",
    },
    timeout=120,
)

response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json()["data"][0]["url"])

parameters.name: image[]
parameters.description: Input image files. Repeat the image[] multipart field for multi-image composition. The gateway also accepts image and image[*] for compatibility.

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: Optional PNG mask file for masked edits.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Number of images to return. Range: 1-10.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Output size, such as auto or WIDTHxHEIGHT.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Image quality, such as low, medium, high, or auto.

parameters.name: output_compression
parameters.description: Compression level for supported output formats.

parameters.name: additional_fields
parameters.description: Additional edit parameters are forwarded as multipart fields.

templates.curl:
curl -X POST {{BASE_URL}}/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{API_KEY}}" \
  -d '{
    "model": "{{MODEL_ID}}",
    "prompt": "A beautiful sunset over the ocean, digital art",
    "n": 1,
    "size": "1024x1024",
    "response_format": "url"
  }'
templates.python:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI(api_key="{{API_KEY}}", base_url="{{BASE_URL}}/v1")
response = client.images.generate(
    model="{{MODEL_ID}}",
    prompt="A beautiful sunset over the ocean, digital art",
    n=1,
    size="1024x1024",
    response_format="url",
)
print(response.data[0].url)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: auto, preset sizes, or custom WIDTHxHEIGHT.
